_doc: Z5 builder fixtures: an iron condor (and a short strangle) evaluated by the builder engine at fixed dates with synthetic prices - not market data. Regenerate with the engine, never by hand.

Sell Put.what: Short put at the money (undefined risk below)

Call Ratio Back Spread.what: Sell 1 ATM call, buy 2 OTM calls

Long Synthetic Future.what: Long call + short put at the same strike

Bullish Risk Reversal.what: Buy an OTM call, sell an OTM put

Bull Call Ladder.what: Bull call spread with one more call sold above (undefined risk above)

Sell Call.what: Short call at the money (undefined risk above)

Put Ratio Back Spread.what: Sell 1 ATM put, buy 2 OTM puts

Short Synthetic Future.what: Long put + short call at the same strike

Bearish Risk Reversal.what: Buy an OTM put, sell an OTM call

Bear Put Ladder.what: Bear put spread with one more put sold below (large risk below)

Short Straddle.what: Sell call and put at the money (undefined risk)

Short Strangle.what: Sell OTM call and put (undefined risk)

Long Call Butterfly.what: Buy wings, sell 2 at the money (calls)

Long Put Butterfly.what: Buy wings, sell 2 at the money (puts)

Call Ratio Spread.what: Buy 1 ATM call, sell 2 OTM calls

Put Ratio Spread.what: Buy 1 ATM put, sell 2 OTM puts

Jade Lizard.what: Short put + short call spread (no upside risk if the credit covers the spread)

Long Call Condor.what: Call condor: a butterfly with a flat top

Long Straddle.what: Buy call and put at the money

Short Iron Condor.what: Long strangle with short wings (defined risk)

Short Iron Butterfly.what: Long straddle with short wings (defined risk)

Call Calendar.what: Sell the near-expiry call, buy the next-expiry call, same strike

Put Calendar.what: Sell the near-expiry put, buy the next-expiry put, same strike

Call Diagonal.what: Buy the next-expiry ATM call, sell a near-expiry OTM call

Put Diagonal.what: Buy the next-expiry ATM put, sell a near-expiry OTM put

Covered Call.what: Own the underlying, sell an OTM call

Protective Put.what: Own the underlying, buy an OTM put

Collar.what: Own the underlying, buy a put, sell a call
